mapper.sql: O_CODE O_CODE, GRADE_ORG_ID GRADE_ORG_ID, GRADE_DATE GRADE_DATE, O_TYPE O_TYPE, SHORT_LONG_TERM SHORT_LONG_TERM, GRADE_RESULT GRADE_RESULT, INPUT_TYPE INPUT_TYPE, CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME, IS_RECOMMAND IS_RECOMMAND, ISSUER_RATE_TYPE ISSUER_RATE_TYPE, NOTICE_DATE NOTICE_DATE, GRADE_EXPECTATION GRADE_EXPECTATION, DIRECTION_CHANGE DIRECTION_CHANGE
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING CII USING (
SELECT '${item.oCode}' O_CODE, '${item.gradeOrgId}' GRADE_ORG_ID, #{item.gradeDate,jdbcType=DATE}null GRADE_DATE, '${item.oType}' O_TYPE, '${item.shortLongTerm}' SHORT_LONG_TERM, '${item.gradeResult}' GRADE_RESULT, '${item.inputType}' INPUT_TYPE, '${item.createUser}' CREATE_USER, '${item.createDept}' CREATE_DEPT, current date CREATE_TIME, '${item.updateUser}' UPDATE_USER, current date UPDATE_TIME, '${item.isRecommand}' IS_RECOMMAND, '${item.issuerRateType}' ISSUER_RATE_TYPE, '${item.noticeDate}' NOTICE_DATE, '${item.gradeExpectation}' GRADE_EXPECTATION, '${item.directionChange}' DIRECTION_CHANGE FROM sysibm.SYSDUMMY1
) TEMP
ON(CII.O_CODE = TEMP.O_CODE and CII.GRADE_ORG_ID = TEMP.GRADE_ORG_ID and CII.GRADE_DATE = TEMP.GRADE_DATE and CII.O_TYPE = TEMP.O_TYPE )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.SHORT_LONG_TERM = TEMP.SHORT_LONG_TERM, CII.GRADE_RESULT = TEMP.GRADE_RESULT, CII.INPUT_TYPE = TEMP.INPUT_TYPE, CII.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CII.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, CII.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CII.IS_RECOMMAND = TEMP.IS_RECOMMAND, CII.ISSUER_RATE_TYPE = TEMP.ISSUER_RATE_TYPE, CII.NOTICE_DATE = TEMP.NOTICE_DATE, CII.GRADE_EXPECTATION = TEMP.GRADE_EXPECTATION, CII.DIRECTION_CHANGE = TEMP.DIRECTION_CHANGE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (O_CODE, GRADE_ORG_ID, GRADE_DATE, O_TYPE, SHORT_LONG_TERM, GRADE_RESULT, INPUT_TYPE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, IS_RECOMMAND, ISSUER_RATE_TYPE, NOTICE_DATE, GRADE_EXPECTATION, DIRECTION_CHANGE) values (TEMP.O_CODE, TEMP.GRADE_ORG_ID, TEMP.GRADE_DATE, TEMP.O_TYPE, TEMP.SHORT_LONG_TERM, TEMP.GRADE_RESULT, TEMP.INPUT_TYPE, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.IS_RECOMMAND, TEMP.ISSUER_RATE_TYPE, TEMP.NOTICE_DATE, TEMP.GRADE_EXPECTATION, TEMP.DIRECTION_CHANGE )
